violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM PRESENT AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. A CFM MUST BE PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: OBSERVED STAINLESS STEEL PANS found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. CFM WILL DISCUSS WITH STAFF PROPER AIR DRYING OF CLEANED COOKE WARE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: SANITIZER DISPENSER AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK NOT FUNCTIONING.
violations.corrective_action: CFM WILL ATTEMPT TO TROUBLESHOOT DISPENSER AND WILL CALL REPAIR COMPANY IF NEEDED. CFM AND EMPLOYEES WILL MANUALLY DISPENSE AND VERIFY CONCENTRATION OF QUATERNARY AMMONIA WHEN FILLING SANITIZER BASIN.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED PIPING UNDERNEATH HAND SINK (NEXT TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK) LEAKING.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. CONTACT PLUMBER TO REPAIR LEAK. MEZEH (Inspection Date: 06/01/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Materials Smooth, Durable, Cleanable
violations.observation: OBSERVED TILED FLOORING IN BACK KITCHEN IN NEED OF RE-GROUTING. OBSERVED ACCUMULATION OF WATER/LIQUID IN BETWEEN TILES.
violations.corrective_action: Wall, floor, and ceiling surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, warewashing areas, and toilet rooms. REPAIR/REGROUT TILES IN KITCHEN.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED FLOORS UNDERNEATH EQUIPMENT WITH ACCUMULATION OF GRIME AND DEBRIS.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CLEAN FLOORS THROUGHOUT KITCHEN AREA.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed gaps in ceiling where piping/electrical wires run.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Seal gaps in ceiling.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. Observed 2024 food establishment posted.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Contact 703-246-2201 or email [county email] to obtain a copy of your 2024 food establishment permit.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: Observed no water flow at hand sink next to 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CFM turned valve below basin to ON position. Leave valves in ON position so that the hand washing sink is accessible at all times.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed chicken on serving line at 112F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Employee removed chicken from line and reheated on flattop to 166-168F.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. Observed residential pesticide can in chemical storage under dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CFM discarded pesticide. Pest issues should be brought to the attention of your pest control company and service requested. MEZEH (Inspection Date: 05/07/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: no thermometer observed in #4.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM placed thermometer in #4.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Observed standing water on floor around 3 compartment sink and dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. EHS recommends purchase of area fan to assist in water evaporation. CFM to investigate sources of water

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Inspect Premises
violations.observation: The premises is not being routinely inspected for the presence of insects, rodents and pests. Observed rodent droppings in back hallway under storage racks.
violations.corrective_action: Insects, rodents and pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Routinely inspect the premises to control the presence of insects, rodents and pests on the premises. EHS recommended thorough cleaning of back kitchen, especially under equipment and storage racks.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved splitter installed on mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS provided product information for approved backflow prevention device. Send proof of purchase to EHS within 3 days.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: OBSERVED RESIDENTIAL PESTICIDE CAN IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CFM DISCARDED RESIDENTIAL PESTICIDE.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 3 DR PREP, #4.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM TO PURCHASE ADDITIONAL COLD HOLDING UNIT THERMOMETERS.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Inspect Premises
violations.observation: The premises is not being routinely inspected for the presence of insects, rodents and pests. OBSERVED RODENT DROPPINGS UNDERNEATH DISH MACHINE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Insects, rodents and pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Routinely inspect the premises to control the presence of insects, rodents and pests on the premises. CFM TO CLEAN AND SANITIZE STORAGE SHELF UNDERNEATH DISH MACHINE. PROVIDE PEST CONTROL RECORD TO EHS.
